cases.translation: The cup was found in Benjamin's sack.
cases.explain: Чаша is the subject of the verb нашлась, so it is in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Зачем же нам воровать серебро или золото из ___ твоего господина?
cases.translation: Why would we steal silver or gold out of your master's house?
cases.explain: The preposition из (out of) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: А вы возвращайтесь к ___ с миром.
cases.translation: But you, return to your father in peace.
cases.explain: The preposition к (toward) governs the dative case.

cases.translation: God has uncovered the guilt of your servants.
cases.explain: The transitive verb открыл (uncovered) takes its direct object in the accusative case.

cases.sentence: А вы возвращайтесь к отцу с ___.
cases.translation: But you, return to your father in peace.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Иуда просит об ___ младшего брата Вениамина.
cases.translation: Judah pleads for the release of his younger brother Benjamin.
cases.explain: The preposition об (about/for) governs the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Иосиф приказал своему управляющему «Наполни мешки этих людей едой, сколько смогут унести, и положи серебро каждому обратно в мешок».
reading.question: What did Joseph order his steward to do with the men's sacks?
options: Fill them with food and put each man's silver back in his sack
Fill them with grain only, no silver
reading.correct: Fill them with food and put each man's silver back in his sack
reading.explain: Joseph tells his steward to fill the sacks with food and return each man's silver to his sack.

reading.ru: «Положи мою чашу, мою серебряную чашу, в мешок к младшему вместе с его серебром за зерно».
reading.question: Where did Joseph tell the steward to put his silver cup?
reading.explain: Joseph orders his silver cup placed in the sack of the youngest brother, Benjamin.

reading.ru: Иосиф сказал управляющему, «Немедленно отправляйся в погоню за этими людьми, и когда догонишь, скажи им».
reading.question: What did Joseph instruct the steward to do after the brothers left?
options: Chase after the men and catch up with them
Wait for them to return on their own
reading.correct: Chase after the men and catch up with them
reading.explain: Joseph tells the steward to pursue the men at once and catch up with them.

reading.question: What accusation did the steward bring against the brothers?
options: That they repaid good with evil
reading.correct: That they repaid good with evil
reading.explain: The steward asks why they repaid good with evil ('заплатили злом за добро').

reading.ru: Если вещь найдется у одного из твоих рабов, пусть он умрет, а остальные станут рабами нашего господина».
reading.question: What did the brothers propose should happen if the cup were found with one of them?
options: That man should die and the rest become slaves
They would give up Benjamin only
reading.correct: That man should die and the rest become slaves
reading.explain: The brothers propose that whoever has the cup should die, and the rest become slaves.

reading.ru: Чаша нашлась в мешке у Вениамина.
reading.question: In whose sack was the cup found?
reading.explain: The text states plainly that the cup was found in Benjamin's sack.

reading.ru: «Что мы можем сказать моему господину?» — ответил Иуда.
reading.question: What did Judah exclaim when confronted about the cup?
options: What can we say to my lord?
We are innocent, let us go!
reading.correct: What can we say to my lord?
reading.explain: Judah responds, 'What can we say to my lord?'

reading.ru: Иосиф сказал, «Разве я стану делать такое? Только тот, у кого нашлась чаша, будет моим рабом, а вы возвращайтесь к Отцу с миром».
reading.question: What did Joseph say would happen to the other brothers?
options: They could return to their father in peace
reading.correct: They could return to their father in peace
reading.explain: Joseph says only the one with the cup will be his slave; the rest may return to their father in peace.

reading.ru: Итак, молю тебя, позволь твоему рабу остаться здесь, рабом моего господина, вместо мальчика, и позволь мальчику вернуться с братьями».
reading.question: What did Judah offer to do in his final plea to Joseph?
options: Stay as a slave in place of Benjamin
Ask Joseph for mercy on his father
reading.correct: Stay as a slave in place of Benjamin
reading.explain: Judah begs to remain as a slave in place of the boy, so that Benjamin may return with his brothers.
